context: Shared infra used by both V1 Burner and V2 BurnerV2. Profiled as context/trust boundary.
purpose: Shared, append-only ledger of token burns across all burn dispatchers. Authorized burners call burn(token, amount) to accumulate totalBurnt[token] and emit a tokenBurnt event. Owner manages the burner allowlist and a token enumeration index.

localFindings.description: burn() records the caller-supplied `amount` with no verification that a real token burn occurred (the recorder cannot observe the burn). An authorized (trusted) burner could inflate totalBurnt. Since burners are owner-approved and the ledger is informational (no value gated on it), this is an accounting-trust note, not a vulnerability. registerToken allows duplicate token entries (no dedupe) — purely cosmetic for enumeration.
localFindings.recommendation: None required; ensure no downstream contract treats totalBurnt as a financial source of truth without independent verification.

valueFlows: No token movement; pure accounting/event ledger. The Burner/BurnerV2 dispatchers are the only writers (must be on the allowlist).
trustAssumptions: Owner approves only honest burner dispatchers.
Downstream consumers treat the ledger as informational, not a value source.
